authority_order: current origin/main and merged PR history

recovery_policy.rule: At every run, reconcile claims and open PR prose against current origin/main and actual merged PRs before selecting work. If a PR no longer contains current main, close/supersede it or publish a fresh exact-main successor; never keep re-reporting it as the current candidate. If a historical blocker is already fixed on main, remove it from the decision path immediately.

unrelated_red_workflow_is_noise_only_if: its owned scope is unrelated to the PR changed paths
its first failing step is an exact-main/bounded-scope/changed-file ownership gate
all substantive terrain/runtime/safety steps after that gate are skipped
the PR records the run/job evidence for that classification
never_ignore: a failure after substantive tests started
a failure in the PR's own scope-specific workflow
ci_authority_policy.rule: Do not require every historical pull_request workflow in the repository to be green. Require every authoritative check for the current scope to be green, and classify any other red workflow as non-authoritative only with explicit first-step scope-gate evidence.

required_before_merge: all authoritative checks are green on the exact head
origin/main still equals the recorded exact base
no overlapping active lease or unresolved relevant blocker exists
the PR head SHA is unchanged
procedure: mark the PR ready for review
require the ready-event PR Main Freshness Guard to pass
merge only with expected-head SHA protection
after merge reconcile ledger/claim and advance to the next valid layer or measured refinement
merge_progression_policy.rule: An agent must not leave its own exact-head fully qualified PR indefinitely as a green draft. If the required checks above are satisfied, progress it through ready-event freshness and expected-head merge; if main moved, do not merge and create a fresh successor instead.

canonical_map_provenance_policy.rule: Canonical identity is version + SHA256 + decoded dimensions. The historical .png filename is not proof of PNG encoding. Detect the byte signature, accept only supported PNG/JPEG encodings, and never transcode the owner bytes because that changes the canonical SHA. Existing merged masks/biome/relief inputs already bound to this SHA may continue to drive later layers; do not invent new raw-pixel evidence while the exact source bytes are unavailable to CI.
